notes: Counts are exact request-selection goals; mode and area fractions are soft target margins and must be reported after selection.
Core only: reserve_min_roundtrip does not silently lower the main-data threshold; reserve is a separate optional ablation.
Plans reference real source regions. Coordinates and training JSONL are not present until explicit materialization and geometry audit.
Training points must survive 0-1000 quantization and lie in S and canonical decode; evaluation points are sampled from S without looking at canonical decode.
Dense category/relations and all supervision fields are never model-visible. Dense rows use the same neutral no-ref instruction.
No image-changing augmentation; original canonical tokens remain attached to the unmodified source image.
